2wkr2: In 2015, artists Dustin Harris and Lea Pinsky worked with a theme of Within/Without and they created a piece that addresses the relationship of oneself to the world. In the center of the mural is a large, brightly painted abstract mandala that radiates waves of energy out the edges. Two statements frame the borders, "Dig Deep Within" and "Give Love Now". As creative partners, husband and wife artists Dustin Harris and Lea Pinsky work together as Mix Masters Murals. They have a passion for working for and with communities to inspire public spaces with large-scale artworks. Since 2005 they have led numerous large-scale mural projects in schools, community centers, and public spaces around Chicago.

This mural was created for ACTIVATE: a project of the Chicago Loop Alliance Foundation.

n65bq: “Year Round 2019” is an artwork by Mauricio Ramirez that that tells a story of how Chicago embraces all four seasons. “One of the most unique things about Chicago is how the seasons highly influence the activity throughout the city. I have chosen to depict this narrative by abstractly using geometrical shapes that hold color that corresponds to their season. All through the mural, you can see how the seasons of color playfully interact with each other.” The artwork will be painted on brick, with some basic site preparation needed including power washing the entirety of the wall.
